text:
alex: noticing alerts from apac-southeast1 edge gateways — dataplane completely silent, control plane shows healthy heartbeats for api-plane though.

maria: seeing the same in Grafana, all egress interfaces at 0pps for ~30s. dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/apac-southeast1/edge

sre_lead: @maria @alex thanks. Can you paste the latest BGP neighbor states from the edge routers? Also any metal provisioning jobs in that region?

alex: grabbing router neighbors now, output:```
Neighbor 10.10.1.1 - State: IDLE (last change 00:00:42)
Neighbor 10.10.1.2 - State: DOWN (last change 00:00:37)
RIB: routes withdrawn to default-gateway
```

kyle: oncall-bot just posted a spike: "edge-proxy egress dropped to 0% for region apac-southeast1" — looks like dataplane blackhole.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT DETECTED: apac-southeast1 edge dataplane silence. Severity: P1. Runbook: /runbooks/edge-silence.md :alarm_clock:

maria: control plane (k8s control plane) pods show healthy. kube-apiserver ok, etcd leader stable. But internal service healthchecks failing for edge-proxy and envoy sidecars. logs show TLS handshake timeouts.

sre_lead: hypothesis: network fabric to edge gateways / upstream transit has a fabric-level flap or BGP blackholing. Immediate actions: 1) start traffic-shift to us-west1 warm pool, 2) enable region fallback routing in transit controller, 3) open a ticket with cloud provider NOC. Who can run the shift?

kyle: I can run a controlled shift — will follow the playbook. Steps: update route policy -> mark apac-southeast1 as drained in traffic-router -> escalate to CDN to purge edges.

alex: before we shift, we should attempt a local quick fix: restart edge-proxy fleet in the region (rolling, 5% at a time) to rule out process-level hang. Also capture tcpdump from one failing host: `tcpdump -ni eth0 port 443 -w /tmp/apac-ghost.pcap`

maria: tcpdump shows SYNs leaving but no SYN-ACKs from upstream, consistent with transit blackhole. sample log: `2026-03-18T21:31:12Z envoy TLS handshake timeout, no response from upstream 172.16.0.12`

sre_lead: ok - treat as network outage. Kyle proceed with traffic shift. I'll contact provider support and SRE-NOC. Maria and Alex, keep collecting pcaps and config snapshots. Ops-bot schedule: `incident:create apac-ghost P1`

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2145 apac-southeast1-edge-ghosting. Pager duty notified.

kyle: executing route change now: applying policy `traffic-router set-region-weight apac-southeast1 0` -> then ramp us-west1 from 10% -> 100% over 3 minutes. Posting progress.

maria: monitoring metrics: ingress TPS to apac-southeast1 dropping, us-west1 increasing. No 5xx spike yet. latency to final clients temporarily increased 200-400ms.

alex: started rolling restart on edge-proxy nodes. first batch 5% succeeded but no change in upstream reachability. still 0pps upstream.

sre_lead: good. Because control plane healthy, we won't failover control-plane endpoints. Keep tracing logs for any auth/TLS regression. Notify product and customer-facing team: "Potential regional outage; traffic being routed to other regions; latency may increase." @maria please post status update to #customer-notifications

maria: posted brief to #customer-notifications and ops-status page.

kyle: route change complete — us-west1 at 100%. Edge traffic stable in fallback region. Continuing to monitor for when provider restores transit.

sre_lead: next steps: 1) provider ticket number and ETA, 2) collect full pcaps and uplink telemetry, 3) runbook: postmortem owner. Assign someone for cost estimate of the failover (eg. cross-region egress & reserved capacity burst).

alex: opened provider ticket 987654321, currently awaiting NOC reply. ETA unknown. Attached preliminary pcap snippets to the incident.

ops-bot: Update: provider NOC acknowledged, investigating BGP fabric flap for APAC PoP.

maria: logging note: we'll keep region in drained state until provider confirms stable upstream. Will also evaluate moving some heavier batch workloads off peak into warm pools to reduce cross-region cost.

sre_lead: thanks team. Triage complete for initial response. We'll continue escalation per incident runbook. Short checklist: customer comms ✔, traffic shifted ✔, pcaps collected ✔, provider engaged ✔.

kyle: adding a quick note: we might want to enable additional health probes in traffic-router to detect this "ghosting" pattern earlier (control-plane alive but dataplane silent). Filing a follow-up ticket for devex. :memo:

maria: +1 on the probe idea. Also adding a regression alert to watch for TLS handshake timeout rate.

alex: standing by for NOC ETA.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-2145 status: mitigation in place, monitoring. Next update in 15m or on provider update."
